items.source: Note that the scope of execution to be repeated includes execution of the test method itself as well as any set up or tear down of the test fixture. When used with the SpringMethodRule, the scope additionally includes preparation of the test instance.
items.translation: 请注意，要重复执行的执行范围包括测试方法本身的执行以及测试夹具的设置或清理。当与SpringMethodRule一起使用时，该范围还包括测试实例的准备。

items.source: The number of times that the annotated test method should be repeated.
items.translation: 应重复注解的测试方法的次数。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of the SpringExtension and JUnit Jupiter
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 SpringExtension 和 JUnit Jupiter。
罗德·约翰逊，萨姆·布拉南
